title: Is Your Car Self-Driving? The 0 to 5 Scale Explained 🚗🤖 #shorts

scenes.text: Your car can steer and brake by itself. Is it self-driving? Engineers grade that from zero to five.
Level zero: you do all the driving. Warning beeps and even emergency braking still count as zero.
Level one: the car handles steering or speed. Level two: both at once. But you must watch the road.
Level three is the big jump. In limited conditions the car drives, and you take over only when it asks.
Level four needs no driver, but only in set conditions. If something goes wrong, it stops safely on its own.
Level five drives anywhere, in any weather. Nobody has built one yet.
The scale isn't about how smart the car is. It's about who's responsible. Would you hand over the wheel? Follow EV Drive for daily car tech.
